title: Bias Unveiled: Investigating Social Bias in LLM-Generated Code

bias_targets.methodology: Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate race attributes (e.g., Asian, White, Black) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.
Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate age attributes (e.g., Under 30, Over 60) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.

Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate employment status attributes (e.g., Employed, Unemployed) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.
Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate education attributes (e.g., High school, Bachelor) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.
Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate gender attributes (e.g., Male, Female, Transgender) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.

Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate religion attributes (e.g., Christianity, Islam, Atheist) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.

Metamorphic testing of LLM-generated code by generating executable test cases that alternate marital status attributes (e.g., Single, Married, Divorced) to check if the code produces inconsistent outcomes.
